Hi there!

Zapier's mission is to make automation work for everyone. That mission is funded by revenue — and every dollar of it flows through our Commerce Zone. We build and operate the infrastructure behind billing, subscriptions, payments, pricing, entitlements, and checkout across everything Zapier ships: self-serve plans, enterprise contracts, and ecosystem offerings. When a customer upgrades, renews, changes plans, or pays an invoice, our systems make it happen — correctly, instantly, and at scale.

We're hiring a Staff Engineer to own the technical vision and long-term architecture for the Commerce Zone. You'll define the pricing primitives, service boundaries, and data models that let Zapier ship pricing and packaging changes in days instead of months — while keeping every dollar accounted for accurately. That means designing the framework and abstractions product teams plug into so they can launch new SKUs without becoming billing experts, building configuration-driven infrastructure for pricing experimentation, and ensuring the platform evolves without foundational rewrites.

This is production-critical, finance-grade infrastructure where correctness is non-negotiable. You'll drive alignment across teams in a space defined by high ambiguity and competing constraints, working closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Sales. The role is particularly exciting because decisions here ripple across Zapier — shaping how the company monetizes its next phase of growth.

About You

  • Proven engineering impact: You've driven outcomes in complex, production systems at scale — shipping projects that delivered measurable improvements in environments where requirements shifted under you. You separate essential from accidental complexity, make tradeoffs explicit, and use data to inform decisions without becoming paralyzed by it. Many strong candidates have 8+ years of experience, but we hire for impact and capability, not tenure.

  • Billing/payments/monetization domain experience: You bring strong domain knowledge in billing systems, subscription management, payment processing, or financial platforms. You understand metered billing, pricing models, entitlements, revenue recognition, and the operational complexity of supporting enterprise customers. You know that billing isn't just a backend problem — it touches sales, finance, support, and product, and you've navigated that reality.

  • API, platform, and performance expertise: You've designed and built APIs that serve multiple consumers — internal teams, external partners, and user-facing products — and you know how to evolve systems without breaking existing integrations. You have a track record of identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks through profiling, caching, database optimization, and delivering measurable improvements that impact user experience and conversion.

  • Outcome-driven and customer-focused: You care deeply about the problems our customers are trying to solve and define success by the results they achieve — not the elegance of the technical solution. You fall in love with the problem, not your first implementation, and are willing to rethink or pivot when it better serves the customer and the business.

  • Cross-team leadership and proactive ownership: You've led technical initiatives that span multiple teams and operate with end-to-end ownership. You gather requirements, surface risks early, align stakeholders, and drive ambiguous problems through to measurable outcomes. You're a trusted partner to Engineering, Product, and Design leadership — helping shape roadmaps, translating business strategy into technical direction, and amplifying other engineers by raising standards and building durable foundations that create leverage across teams.

  • AI fluency: You use AI coding tools as a regular part of your workflow and have a point of view on where they accelerate delivery and where human judgment is non-negotiable. In a high-correctness domain like payments and billing, you know the difference between automating boilerplate and trusting AI with revenue logic — and you bring that judgment to the engineers you work with.

  • Comfort with complexity: You're at home in large, mature codebases — you know how to navigate a monolith, find the right leverage points, and make meaningful progress without waiting for a clean slate.

Things You’ll Do

  • Serve as a technical leader within the Commerce Zone: You’ll operate as part of the zone’s leadership team, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and Design to shape strategy and roadmap decisions. You’ll translate business context into technical direction—and ensure engineering tradeoffs are clearly understood at the business level.

  • Shape the long-term platform vision: You’ll define and evolve the architectural direction of the Commerce Zone, balancing near-term delivery with long-term durability, extensibility, and operational excellence.

  • Lead high-impact technical initiatives: You’ll drive the strategic evolution of our monetization platform—decoupling billing from account systems, clarifying system boundaries, and consolidating pricing infrastructure. You’ll build flexible, configurable foundations that enable fast Pricing and Packaging experimentation and seamless launch moments across the customer lifecycle, while supporting clean, reliable data for Finance and Pricing & Packaging.

  • Own and strengthen revenue-critical systems: You’ll be responsible for systems across the Commerce Zone—Billing, Pricing, Payments, Checkout, and Entitlements—ensuring they are resilient, observable, and correct. You’ll raise the bar on proactive detection, safe rollback mechanisms, and revenue accuracy—catching issues before customers do. You’ll systematically reduce structural and technical debt, eliminate recurring operational pain points, and strengthen architectural foundations to prevent revenue-impacting incidents before they emerge.

  • Guide high-impact technical decisions: You’ll influence API design, data modeling, caching strategies, and system architecture—optimizing for scalability, developer experience, and rapid pricing and packaging iteration.

  • Partner deeply across Zapier: You’ll collaborate closely with Pricing & Packaging, Product, and Design teams to drive ARR growth and craft seamless, intuitive, and lovable monetization journeys for self-serve, enterprise, and ecosystem customers. You’ll also work with Support and Operations to ensure robust admin tooling and exceptional customer experiences across upgrades, billing changes, and subscription management.

  • Drive measurable improvements: You’ll identify performance bottlenecks and deliver optimizations that show up in the metrics—reduced latency, improved reliability, stronger customer experiences, and improved conversion and retention.

  • Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar: You’ll share patterns and tooling, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and grow engineering capability across the zone. You’ll be a go-to resource for engineers tackling complex monetization and platform challenges.

  • Champion documentation and developer experience: You’ll ensure our systems are well-documented and easy to adopt, reducing friction and accelerating development across the organization.

Hi there!

As Zapier expands into the enterprise market and accelerates AI-driven development, incident management is increasingly critical to customer trust and operational reliability. The Incident Operations Specialist keeps that program running day to day through reliable tooling, clean data, repeatable workflows, and AI-powered automation.

You’ll report to the Incident Program Manager and help shape how Zapier responds to incidents, learns from them, and supports the people doing that work. This is an operations role with technical depth, not a software engineering role. We care most about two things: proven incident management experience and genuine AI fluency. The rest is coachable.

What we're looking for

AI fluency (required, not optional). This is a hard requirement at point of hire, not something you'll grow into on the job. Concretely, we're looking for:

  • You use AI-native tools (Cursor, Claude, Copilot, or similar) as your default working environment, not as a novelty.

  • You've built AI-powered workflows that keep running when you're offline, not one-off prompts. You can describe two or three specific examples, what they replaced, and what verification you built in.

  • You can quantify how AI has changed your throughput or quality.

  • You know when AI output needs checking, especially under incident-time pressure, and you have a point of view on how you calibrate trust.

  • Please note: If your AI usage is mostly occasional prompting of a chat interface, this role isn't the right fit yet.

Incident response and analysis experience: You've worked in incident response, reliability, or a closely adjacent role. You've been hands-on with tools like incident.io and PagerDuty: on-call rotations, escalation paths, routing, integrations. You've analysed incidents after the fact, spotted patterns across many of them, and turned that into program-level improvements.

Technical depth to build your own tools: You're not a software engineer, but you can write SQL against Databricks, wire up API integrations, build Slack workflows, and prototype lightweight AI agents. If a workflow doesn't exist, you build it. If a dashboard is broken, you fix it.

How you work: Async-first and visible: status in public channels, no need to chase. You close the loop, prioritise ruthlessly, and push back on off-program requests rather than getting pulled thin. You translate technical detail into plain language for Support, GTM, and leadership without losing the signal.

What you'll do

  • Own incident tooling operations. Keep incident.io, PagerDuty, on-call rotations, escalation paths, and Slack-based workflows configured, reliable, and integrated. Fix what breaks.

  • Build and maintain AI-powered workflows. Thread summarisation, postmortem drafting, follow-up triage, severity classification, data hygiene. Turn one-off experiments into durable systems.

  • Analyze incidents and drive improvement. Participate in incidents and postmortems, spot recurring patterns, surface program-level friction with recommended fixes, not just problems.

  • Operate data and reporting. Build and troubleshoot dashboards and reports (Databricks, Grafana, Looker). Guard data quality and metric accuracy.

  • Sustain the IC community. Grow the community of practice for Incident Commanders and Support Leads. Coach responders on what good looks like.

  • Keep documentation usable under pressure. Playbooks, templates, guides. Flag gaps where program-level guidance needs updating.

Our stack

  • Incident: incident.io, PagerDuty, Slack

  • Data and observability: Databricks, Grafana, Looker, SQL, Datadog, Prometheus, Opensearch, Graylog

  • AI: Cursor, Zapier AI, Claude, or equivalent

  • Collaboration: GitLab, Coda, Google Workspace, Jira, Zendesk

Hi there!

Zapier is hiring a Manager, Analytics & Strategy to lead our newly formed GTM Analytics team. This team is the central analytics home for Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Customer Ops, with a mandate to deliver trusted GTM insights, improve the quality and speed of decision-making, and turn repeated questions into durable self-service analytics assets.

You will manage a team of embedded analysts supporting Marketing, Sales, and Support/Customer Ops. Your team will own the day-to-day analytics interface for GTM leaders: funnel reporting, campaign performance, sales and support analytics, forecasting inputs, recurring business reviews, dashboarding, metric definitions, and urgent executive questions.

This is a hands-on analytics leadership role. we're looking for someone who has deep analytics judgment, strong SQL skills, and real GTM domain expertise. You might come from a sales analytics, marketing analytics, revenue analytics, finance, or investment banking environment. The common thread is that you know how to operate with urgency, precision, and a high quality bar, and you are energized by analytics work: scoping ambiguous business questions, pressure-testing numbers, coaching people through complex GTM data questions, and delivering clear recommendations under time pressure.

This is not a pure people-management role. You should be able to lean into advanced analytics, understand core statistical concepts, and guide work on experimentation, forecasting, or segmentation when the work calls for it, but the center of gravity is analytics leadership: trusted reporting, business partnership, analytical QA, stakeholder management, and building a faster, more consistent operating model for GTM data. You should also be AI-native in how you work and excited to make this team a proving ground for self-service analytics, analyst automation, and governed AI-assisted data workflows.

About You

You have managed analysts or analytics-adjacent teams for at least 1 year, but you are still comfortable rolling up your sleeves to review SQL, inspect a dashboard, pressure-test assumptions, and help frame the answer.

You have strong GTM analytics expertise. You understand how marketing, sales, customer operations, and revenue motions fit together. You have worked with funnels, pipeline, bookings or ARR, campaign performance, sales productivity, support performance, forecasting, attribution, segmentation, or lifecycle analytics. You know how to translate GTM questions into metrics, cuts, cohorts, and recommendations that leaders can act on.

You are excellent with SQL and analytical reasoning. You read and write SQL, reason about grain and joins, identify data quality issues, and coach analysts toward cleaner, more reliable methods. You are comfortable with statistics and advanced analytics concepts such as confidence intervals, incrementality, cohorting, regression, forecasting, and experiment readouts, and you know when to partner with Data Science for heavier modeling work.

You bring finance-grade rigor and urgency. You can operate in a fast-twitch environment where leaders need clear answers quickly. You know how to separate what must be directionally right today from what needs a deeper follow-up, and you keep quality high even when timelines are short. Experience in investment banking, finance, FP&A, revenue analytics, or another high-intensity analytical environment is a strong plus.

You set a high bar for quality, trust, and communication. You know that GTM analytics only works when stakeholders trust the numbers. You build review mechanisms, documentation habits, and QA standards that make dashboards and analyses easier to trust. You can explain caveats without hiding behind them, and you help teams align on source-of-truth metrics across Data, Finance, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Ops.

You are an excellent manager and coach. You raise the performance of analysts through clear expectations, thoughtful feedback, technical coaching, and strong prioritization. You know how to help analysts grow and coach them through ambiguous requests and work that should be automated or moved into self-service.

You are AI-native and automation-minded. You actively use modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, QA SQL, summarize stakeholder context, produce documentation, and prototype workflows. You are excited to make AI central to the team's operating model, and to turn repeated analyst workflows into governed self-service assets, AI primitives, reusable dashboards, or model improvements.

You can manage across analysts and data engineers. You understand the difference between stakeholder-facing analytics and data foundation work, and you help both groups work together effectively.

  • Lead the Analytics & Strategy team, managing analysts embedded with Marketing, Sales, and Support/Customer Ops.

  • Build a fast, trusted operating model for intake, prioritization, QA, stakeholder communication, and recurring business reviews.

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Security Functional Team, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring our security capabilities keep pace with our rapid product development, including our expanding AI offerings like Duck.ai and agentic browsing, directly protecting our users across all our products. You'll also maintain incident detection and response capabilities for the company, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • SERP security mitigations

  • Agentic browsing security mitigations

  • Agentic browser hardening

  • Browser and sync security audits

As a Senior Security Engineer, App Sec, you'll execute on SERP security mitigations (XSS prevention, tooling development to help engineers write safer code), manage application security scanning infrastructure setup, build and maintain harnesses that get security fixes out automatically, harden our agentic browsing and DuckAI experiences against emerging threats (like prompt injection), conduct browser and sync security audits (special pages, DuckAI integrations, password manager, etc.), deliver on internal red-team operations (simulated attack scenarios), support security triage, and more!

About You

  • 7+ years of experience in web or application security (performing security assessments, vulnerability research, penetration testing, or secure code review)

  • Recent experience creating security focused agentic harnesses

  • Experience influencing large feature designs to have security baked in from the start

  • Advanced programming or scripting experience with JavaScript. Any additional experience with our stack is a bonus: Swift/Kotlin/C#/JavaScript (native apps) or JavaScript/Perl/Go (search).

  • An understanding of the web security model (such as the Same Origin Policy); experience with CSP, CORS, SameSite cookies, sec-fetch-*, CORB, CORP, Sanitizer API, and Trusted Types is beneficial

  • Hands-on experience identifying and exploiting web vulnerabilities (XSS, CSRF, injection attacks, authorization flaws, etc.)

  • Familiarity with security testing tools and frameworks

  • Experience partnering and collaborating with Product Engineers, advising on security matters and helping teams ship secure code faster

  • Experience shaping how an organisation thinks about security - driving best practices, improving processes, and raising the bar across teams

Compensation

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

As a Senior Product Design Engineer, you'll collaborate across levels to solve problems in our current products and pioneer new ones as we build the privacy layer for the Internet. You'll autonomously lead high-impact projects at scale from ideation to execution with a voice in product design decisions large and small.

 

About You

  1. 7+ years in product design roles, including 2+ years senior-level at significant global consumer brands

  2. Pushes creative limits on hard design problems, delivering delight, craft, and exceptional quality

  3. Communicates visual and interaction recommendations through high-quality mockups, rationale, prototypes, and specific motion variables

  4. Partners with engineers as a peer — reasoning about decisions in PR reviews, contributing code where it raises design quality

  5. Prototypes in code to a production standard, with an understanding of semantic markup and accessibility, leveraging but not relying on AI

  6. Experience structuring a design system beyond component inventory: token layering, primitive vs. semantic naming, design-to-code parity

  7. Proficient in research and experimentation, using both qualitative and quantitative data, comfortable instrumenting your own work

  8. Experience participating in multiple areas of the product process including prioritization, strategy, and user testing

  9. Takes initiative - generates ideas and carries them forward with urgency and discretion, while working openly

  10. Experience defining requirements and building tools that accelerate design and engineering workflows while retaining design system quality and consistency

As a Growth Manager, you're responsible for owning the growth motion for one of our brands end to end. You will set the strategy, ship the work, measure the outcomes, and decide what to build next. This is a hands-on operator role, not a manager-of-managers role. You will not be briefing agencies or waiting for tickets. You will be doing the work, with AI as your leverage.

The brand you join is an established product with a real audience and channels already in place, so this is not a launch. Email and lifecycle marketing sits at the center of the work, with conversion rate optimization alongside it, and content, social, and automation around both.

💡 Interested in applying?

🔍 Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.

Attention to detail is one of our core values! This is your chance to stand out :)

To love this role, here’s the type of person you are:

  • Hands-on operator. You enjoy doing the work yourself rather than briefing it out.
  • AI-first workflow is your bar. A campaign that used to take a small team a week should ship in a day or two through your AI workflow, without the output looking generic.
  • Velocity matters to you. Success in the first 60 to 90 days is measured by acceleration of output, how many things you ship, how quickly you learn from them, and what you do with the learnings.
  • Self-directed. You bring ideas to leadership based on data. You do not wait for someone to tell you what to test next.
  • Curious about new tools as they ship. You try them, keep the ones that improve the work, and drop the ones that do not, rather than waiting for something to become standard before adopting it.

Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Email and lifecycle marketing as the central engine: newsletters, lifecycle automations, segmentation, A/B testing across subject lines, copy, CTAs, send times, and offers. For several of our brands, email is the highest-leverage channel and the place where the biggest wins live.
  • Conversion rate optimization across landing pages, sign-up flows, pricing pages, and checkout. Hypothesis, test, read, decide.
  • Content and copy production: blog posts, landing pages, email copy, lead magnets, social content. Shipped at velocity with AI leverage.
  • Social presence on the channels that matter for your brand. Platform-native treatment, hooks, formats, and pacing tuned to where the content lives.
  • Marketing automation workflows in n8n, Make, Zapier, or equivalent. Connecting your tools into systems that run without you.
  • Weekly analytics review across GA4, email platform reporting, and channel dashboards. Identifying what is working, iterating on what is not, bringing data-backed ideas to leadership.
  • Working closely with the brand General Manager, product team, support, SEO, and the central Awesome Motive growth team.

Requirements

  • Operator background. 5+ years of growth marketing as the only or founding marketer at a B2B SaaS, or as the operator inside a small growth team where you owned full execution.
  • Real AI-augmented work. Specific workflows, specific tools used daily, specific outputs that AI made possible. Not "I use ChatGPT for research" but real systems.
  • Email and lifecycle depth. You have owned an email program at a SaaS company. You know the metrics that matter and have shipped programs that moved them.
  • CRO chops. You have run real experiments on real pages with real data. You can talk through your wins and your losses.
  • Full-stack execution. Copy plus landing page plus email plus campaign plus analysis. You can carry a piece of work from idea to live without waiting on anyone.
  • Hungry over knowledgeable. You learn new tools quickly, drop old ones without ego, and treat your skill stack as something you upgrade continuously.
  • Sharp communication. You work async with US-based teams daily. Your writing is clear, your updates are concise, and you communicate without needing a meeting.
  • Time zone. Minimum 9 AM to 1 PM EST overlap. Some brands have tighter overlap requirements.
  • If your strongest work happened inside a small growth team rather than truly solo, and you owned a meaningful slice end to end, tell us how the work happened and we will figure it out together. The bar is real execution ownership, not titles.

Bonus points if you also have:

  • Public proof of your AI-augmented work. A newsletter, YouTube channel, X presence, Substack, podcast, or personal site where you have written about or demonstrated your workflow.
  • Zero-to-one experience. You have built an audience, a brand, a community, or a product from nothing and grown it to meaningful scale.
  • WordPress ecosystem familiarity. You can stand up a site, install plugins, and ask the right questions. Several of our brands serve WordPress site owners, so this helps.
  • Specific revenue or growth wins. Numbers you can point to: ARR contribution, conversion lift, list growth, audience growth, revenue per send improvements.
  • A point of view on where marketing is going as AI continues to reshape the function, and proof you are actively investing in that direction.

Benefits

Working for a fast-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here’s what we offer.

  • Competitive Salary.
  • Term Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment for all full-time team members during their employment.
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance benefits for full-time U.S. employees.
  • Health Insurance benefits for all employees in Argentina, Brazil, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Jamaica, Kenya, Mexico, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Spain, and Ukraine.
  • Work from your home. We’re spread out all over the world – United States, Canada, Ukraine, India, Pakistan, Singapore, and more.
  • Flexible PTO after 90 days of employment. We encourage employees to take the time they need for a vacation, stay healthy, and spend time with friends and family.
  • Holidays (based on your location)
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • We happily provide or reimburse software you’ll need as well as books or courses that promote continued learning.
  • We cover all costs of company travel (including our annual all-company retreat and mini-team meetups).
  • Additional Perks include AM Welcome Box for new team members, Yearly Anniversary Gifts, and Technology Stipend each work anniversary.
  • We give you the opportunity to solve challenging and meaningful problems that make a difference.
  • Ability to work with some of the best people in the business through frequent, if not daily, interactions.
  • And in case you were wondering: no politics, no b.s., and no jerks.

Location
This is a remote position - our team is spread around the globe! Our home base is in Florida, USA, so company operating hours are 9am - 5pm ET (UTC -5). While full coverage is not a requirement, you must be available during a portion of the day.

Inclusion Statement
At Awesome Motive, we strive to have the broadest possible view of diversity, going beyond visible differences to include the background, experiences, skills, and perspectives that make each person unique. Awesome Motive is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

How to apply?
If all of this sounds interesting, then please submit your application!

Also note, don't forget to proofread before submitting. Check spelling, capitalization, etc. This is your chance to make your application stand out :)

We won’t be able to individually respond to all applications, but if we feel you’re a strong match, someone will be in touch shortly.

Thanks and we look forward to hearing from you!

As a Growth Manager, you're responsible for owning the growth motion for one of our brands end to end. You will set the strategy, ship the work, measure the outcomes, and decide what to build next. This is a hands-on operator role, not a manager-of-managers role. You will not be briefing agencies or waiting for tickets. You will be doing the work, with AI as your leverage.

The brand you join is an established product with a real audience and channels already in place, so this is not a launch. Email and lifecycle marketing sits at the center of the work, with conversion rate optimization alongside it, and content, social, and automation around both.

💡 Interested in applying?

🔍 Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.

Attention to detail is one of our core values! This is your chance to stand out :)

To love this role, here’s the type of person you are:

  • Hands-on operator. You enjoy doing the work yourself rather than briefing it out.
  • AI-first workflow is your bar. A campaign that used to take a small team a week should ship in a day or two through your AI workflow, without the output looking generic.
  • Velocity matters to you. Success in the first 60 to 90 days is measured by acceleration of output, how many things you ship, how quickly you learn from them, and what you do with the learnings.
  • Self-directed. You bring ideas to leadership based on data. You do not wait for someone to tell you what to test next.
  • Curious about new tools as they ship. You try them, keep the ones that improve the work, and drop the ones that do not, rather than waiting for something to become standard before adopting it.

Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Email and lifecycle marketing as the central engine: newsletters, lifecycle automations, segmentation, A/B testing across subject lines, copy, CTAs, send times, and offers. For several of our brands, email is the highest-leverage channel and the place where the biggest wins live.
  • Conversion rate optimization across landing pages, sign-up flows, pricing pages, and checkout. Hypothesis, test, read, decide.
  • Content and copy production: blog posts, landing pages, email copy, lead magnets, social content. Shipped at velocity with AI leverage.
  • Social presence on the channels that matter for your brand. Platform-native treatment, hooks, formats, and pacing tuned to where the content lives.
  • Marketing automation workflows in n8n, Make, Zapier, or equivalent. Connecting your tools into systems that run without you.
  • Weekly analytics review across GA4, email platform reporting, and channel dashboards. Identifying what is working, iterating on what is not, bringing data-backed ideas to leadership.
  • Working closely with the brand General Manager, product team, support, SEO, and the central Awesome Motive growth team.

Requirements

  • Operator background. 5+ years of growth marketing as the only or founding marketer at a B2B SaaS, or as the operator inside a small growth team where you owned full execution.
  • Real AI-augmented work. Specific workflows, specific tools used daily, specific outputs that AI made possible. Not "I use ChatGPT for research" but real systems.
  • Email and lifecycle depth. You have owned an email program at a SaaS company. You know the metrics that matter and have shipped programs that moved them.
  • CRO chops. You have run real experiments on real pages with real data. You can talk through your wins and your losses.
  • Full-stack execution. Copy plus landing page plus email plus campaign plus analysis. You can carry a piece of work from idea to live without waiting on anyone.
  • Hungry over knowledgeable. You learn new tools quickly, drop old ones without ego, and treat your skill stack as something you upgrade continuously.
  • Sharp communication. You work async with US-based teams daily. Your writing is clear, your updates are concise, and you communicate without needing a meeting.
  • Time zone. Minimum 9 AM to 1 PM EST overlap. Some brands have tighter overlap requirements.
  • If your strongest work happened inside a small growth team rather than truly solo, and you owned a meaningful slice end to end, tell us how the work happened and we will figure it out together. The bar is real execution ownership, not titles.

Bonus points if you also have:

  • Public proof of your AI-augmented work. A newsletter, YouTube channel, X presence, Substack, podcast, or personal site where you have written about or demonstrated your workflow.
  • Zero-to-one experience. You have built an audience, a brand, a community, or a product from nothing and grown it to meaningful scale.
  • WordPress ecosystem familiarity. You can stand up a site, install plugins, and ask the right questions. Several of our brands serve WordPress site owners, so this helps.
  • Specific revenue or growth wins. Numbers you can point to: ARR contribution, conversion lift, list growth, audience growth, revenue per send improvements.
  • A point of view on where marketing is going as AI continues to reshape the function, and proof you are actively investing in that direction.

As a Growth Manager, you're responsible for owning the growth motion for one of our brands end to end. You will set the strategy, ship the work, measure the outcomes, and decide what to build next. This is a hands-on operator role, not a manager-of-managers role. You will not be briefing agencies or waiting for tickets. You will be doing the work, with AI as your leverage.

The brand you join is an established product with a real audience and channels already in place, so this is not a launch. Email and lifecycle marketing sits at the center of the work, with conversion rate optimization alongside it, and content, social, and automation around both.

💡 Interested in applying?

🔍 Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.

Attention to detail is one of our core values! This is your chance to stand out :)

To love this role, here’s the type of person you are:

  • Hands-on operator. You enjoy doing the work yourself rather than briefing it out.
  • AI-first workflow is your bar. A campaign that used to take a small team a week should ship in a day or two through your AI workflow, without the output looking generic.
  • Velocity matters to you. Success in the first 60 to 90 days is measured by acceleration of output, how many things you ship, how quickly you learn from them, and what you do with the learnings.
  • Self-directed. You bring ideas to leadership based on data. You do not wait for someone to tell you what to test next.
  • Curious about new tools as they ship. You try them, keep the ones that improve the work, and drop the ones that do not, rather than waiting for something to become standard before adopting it.

Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Email and lifecycle marketing as the central engine: newsletters, lifecycle automations, segmentation, A/B testing across subject lines, copy, CTAs, send times, and offers. For several of our brands, email is the highest-leverage channel and the place where the biggest wins live.
  • Conversion rate optimization across landing pages, sign-up flows, pricing pages, and checkout. Hypothesis, test, read, decide.
  • Content and copy production: blog posts, landing pages, email copy, lead magnets, social content. Shipped at velocity with AI leverage.
  • Social presence on the channels that matter for your brand. Platform-native treatment, hooks, formats, and pacing tuned to where the content lives.
  • Marketing automation workflows in n8n, Make, Zapier, or equivalent. Connecting your tools into systems that run without you.
  • Weekly analytics review across GA4, email platform reporting, and channel dashboards. Identifying what is working, iterating on what is not, bringing data-backed ideas to leadership.
  • Working closely with the brand General Manager, product team, support, SEO, and the central Awesome Motive growth team.

Requirements

  • Operator background. 5+ years of growth marketing as the only or founding marketer at a B2B SaaS, or as the operator inside a small growth team where you owned full execution.
  • Real AI-augmented work. Specific workflows, specific tools used daily, specific outputs that AI made possible. Not "I use ChatGPT for research" but real systems.
  • Email and lifecycle depth. You have owned an email program at a SaaS company. You know the metrics that matter and have shipped programs that moved them.
  • CRO chops. You have run real experiments on real pages with real data. You can talk through your wins and your losses.
  • Full-stack execution. Copy plus landing page plus email plus campaign plus analysis. You can carry a piece of work from idea to live without waiting on anyone.
  • Hungry over knowledgeable. You learn new tools quickly, drop old ones without ego, and treat your skill stack as something you upgrade continuously.
  • Sharp communication. You work async with US-based teams daily. Your writing is clear, your updates are concise, and you communicate without needing a meeting.
  • Time zone. Minimum 9 AM to 1 PM EST overlap. Some brands have tighter overlap requirements.
  • If your strongest work happened inside a small growth team rather than truly solo, and you owned a meaningful slice end to end, tell us how the work happened and we will figure it out together. The bar is real execution ownership, not titles.

Bonus points if you also have:

  • Public proof of your AI-augmented work. A newsletter, YouTube channel, X presence, Substack, podcast, or personal site where you have written about or demonstrated your workflow.
  • Zero-to-one experience. You have built an audience, a brand, a community, or a product from nothing and grown it to meaningful scale.
  • WordPress ecosystem familiarity. You can stand up a site, install plugins, and ask the right questions. Several of our brands serve WordPress site owners, so this helps.
  • Specific revenue or growth wins. Numbers you can point to: ARR contribution, conversion lift, list growth, audience growth, revenue per send improvements.
  • A point of view on where marketing is going as AI continues to reshape the function, and proof you are actively investing in that direction.

Benefits

Working for a fast-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here’s what we offer.

  • Competitive Salary.
  • Term Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment for all full-time team members during their employment.
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance benefits for full-time U.S. employees.
  • Health Insurance benefits for all employees in Argentina, Brazil, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Jamaica, Kenya, Mexico, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Spain, and Ukraine.
  • Work from your home. We’re spread out all over the world – United States, Canada, Ukraine, India, Pakistan, Singapore, and more.
  • Flexible PTO after 90 days of employment. We encourage employees to take the time they need for a vacation, stay healthy, and spend time with friends and family.
  • Holidays (based on your location)
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • We happily provide or reimburse software you’ll need as well as books or courses that promote continued learning.
  • We cover all costs of company travel (including our annual all-company retreat and mini-team meetups).
  • Additional Perks include AM Welcome Box for new team members, Yearly Anniversary Gifts, and Technology Stipend each work anniversary.
  • We give you the opportunity to solve challenging and meaningful problems that make a difference.
  • Ability to work with some of the best people in the business through frequent, if not daily, interactions.
  • And in case you were wondering: no politics, no b.s., and no jerks.

Location
This is a remote position - our team is spread around the globe! Our home base is in Florida, USA, so company operating hours are 9am - 5pm ET (UTC -5). While full coverage is not a requirement, you must be available during a portion of the day.

Inclusion Statement
At Awesome Motive, we strive to have the broadest possible view of diversity, going beyond visible differences to include the background, experiences, skills, and perspectives that make each person unique. Awesome Motive is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

How to apply?
If all of this sounds interesting, then please submit your application!

Also note, don't forget to proofread before submitting. Check spelling, capitalization, etc. This is your chance to make your application stand out :)

We won’t be able to individually respond to all applications, but if we feel you’re a strong match, someone will be in touch shortly.

🌍 Global SaaS Scale-up | Series B
💡 Personalised 1:1 Coaching 
📍 Barcelona, Hybrid (4 days in-office)

About CloudTalk

CloudTalk is THE global AI-powered business calling platform, trusted by 30,000+ professionals at companies like Nokia, Revolut, Glovo, and Uber.

We’re building the world’s most capable AI business calling software available in 160+ countries — helping businesses have more and better calls every day. Backed by $35.3M in funding from leading investors, including KPN Ventures, Point Nine, and HenQ, we're investing in making AI native to every conversation.

We're a ~200-person team that values growth, innovation, teamwork, customer focus, and human connection. We move fast, build for the future, and care deeply about creating products — and a culture — that people genuinely love.

Why Join CloudTalk Now?

We're in an era of rapid innovation — taking our top-tier communication infrastructure to the next level by integrating cutting-edge AI. Join us as we pioneer the future of business communication and drive toward $100M ARR.

🚀Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing SaaS companies

🤖 Work with cutting-edge AI products in a high-growth market. From real-time call intelligence, automated summaries, and AI coaching to AI voice agents and AI receptionists that are transforming how our clients handle volume at scale

🎯 Have a front-row seat in our journey to $100M ARR

The Role

Our Account Managers are the business owners of their portfolio. This is a quota-carrying role where you will own Customer Retention and Portfolio Expansion. You will be a trusted strategic partner to your clients, accountable for their success metrics and the health of your book of business.

This is not a reactive support role. We need someone who runs their portfolio like a business: setting health benchmarks, building save plays before risk surfaces, and consistently translating CloudTalk's capabilities into measurable ROI for clients.

What You Will Do

Be the Strategic Business Partner

Run regular Executive Business Reviews that tie CloudTalk performance directly to your clients' KPIs. Position yourself as a trusted advisor — not just a vendor contact — and build durable relationships with decision makers and executive stakeholders.

Own Retention & Expansion

Lead the full renewal cycle across your portfolio — forecast risk, build proactive save strategies, and consistently hit retention targets quarter over quarter. Churn on your accounts should never come as a surprise.

Identify and close organic growth opportunities within your portfolio — whether that's increased seat count, platform adoption, or premium add-ons. You should know your accounts well enough to see expansion plays before clients do.

Own Portfolio Health

Build and maintain customer health frameworks for your book of business. Define the leading indicators that matter, track them in HubSpot and your analytics stack, and intervene early — before issues become escalations.

Act as the Internal Advocate

Be the voice of your clients inside CloudTalk. Partner closely with Product, Support, and Customer Engineering to resolve issues, surface feedback, and influence the roadmap — while confidently representing CloudTalk's direction back to your accounts.

What Makes You a Great Fit

We're looking for experienced Account Managers or Customer Success Managers who've owned meaningful books of business in B2B SaaS — not just managed relationships, but driven commercial outcomes.

  • Hands-on experience in Account Management or Customer Success in B2B SaaS, with a demonstrable track record of hitting retention and expansion targets
  • Proven ownership of a book of business independently — you've managed renewals, run save plays, and grown accounts without heavy oversight
  • Experience owning customer health metrics: you've built or worked within health score frameworks and used leading indicators to drive proactive action
  • Comfortable running Executive Business Reviews and navigating multi-stakeholder accounts up to C-suite
  • Highly commercial mindset — you think like a revenue owner, not just a relationship manager
  • Data-driven: comfortable in Excel/Sheets, BI dashboards, and CRM reporting to manage your portfolio analytically
  • Technical aptitude — you enjoy learning SaaS products deeply and can guide customers to maximise platform value
  • Familiarity with CS/AM tooling: HubSpot, Gainsight, Planhat, or similar
  • Business fluency in English. Spanish, French, or Czech/Slovak are a big plus.

Why you will love to be a CloudTalker:

Growth:
💡 1-1 Coaching sessions with our resident communications advisor

🤖 AI Enablement: Everything you need to do your best work with AI—from AI Champions and office hours to our AI L&D Hub and dedicated Slack support

Flexibility:

🏖 Unlimited Paid Time Off
🎗️ Volunteering Days
💻 MacBook for work 

Well-being:
🏖Recharge Fridays once per quarter
🏋🏼‍♀️Fitness Allowance

Connectedness:
💲 Referral bonuses
👥 Virtual & physical team buildings
👕 Company merchandise

Apply now and be part of our journey to $100M ARR!

The Role

CloudTalk is building a best-in-class Channel Program — and we’re looking for a Senior Channel Manager to help us do that.

You’ll step into a focused, early-stage partnerships team with strong foundations and growing momentum. Your mission? Build and grow a portfolio of solution partners across EMEA and beyond, turning those relationships into consistent, repeatable revenue.

You’ll be responsible for recruiting new partners, enabling them to position CloudTalk effectively, and working with them to close their first CloudTalk sales. Experience in the CRM or VoIP ecosystem will serve you well — especially if you’ve already built relationships in this space.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. We’re looking for someone who can manage a partner portfolio with minimal oversight, help us scale both revenue and reach, and move quickly from idea to action.

What You Will Do

  • Partner Recruitment – Identify, engage, and sign high-potential partners across EMEA and beyond
  • Partner Activation & Management – Onboard and educate new partners, then work with them to launch their first campaigns and generate traction
  • Co-selling & Support – Support partners throughout the sales cycle—from qualification to close—with hands-on help and advice
  • Creative Demand Generation – Test and develop new ways to drive demand through partners—whether co-marketing, referrals, outbound plays, or something new
  • Feedback Loops – Feed insights back to the team to improve partner experience, positioning, and operations
  • Reporting & Forecasting – Track partner performance, revenue contribution, and forecast accurately

You’re a commercially minded operator who knows how to make partner relationships deliver results. You’ve managed channel partners before and know what it takes to activate and scale them. job.job_title: CISO / Head of IT Security - Fulltime Hybrid
job.job_description:
About Us

Ikerian AG (formerly RetinAI Medical) is a fast-growing medical device software company headquartered in Bern, Switzerland. Our mission is to enable the right decisions sooner in healthcare, through transformative AI & data management solutions for disease screening and monitoring. Join our diverse team of entrepreneurs, developers, researchers, and commercial experts who are collectively shaping the future of healthcare.

The Role

We are seeking a CISO / Head of IT Security to lead our security strategy and internal IT operations. This role is pivotal in safeguarding our digital assets and ensuring the highest standards of data privacy within the medical device software landscape. You will bridge the gap between technical security measures and the strategic needs of our growing global team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and implement the company-wide information security strategy and roadmap.
  • Oversee IT infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security across all systems.
  • Lead compliance efforts for relevant standards such as ISO 27001, SOC2, HIPAA, and GDPR.
  • Manage risk assessments, vulnerability testing, and incident response protocols.
  • Supervise the procurement and management of hardware/software for a distributed workforce.
  • Foster a culture of security awareness through continuous training and policy development.

Requirements

  • 8 years of experience in a similar position (Finance sector start search)
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial and collaborative mindset.
  • University degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; professional certifications (CISSP, CISM) preferred.
  • Significant experience in information security and IT leadership, ideally within the healthcare or finance industry.
  • Expertise in cloud security architecture (AWS) and modern infrastructure tools.
  • Proven ability to manage complex IT projects and data privacy initiatives.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

Benefits

  • A chance to be part of an exceptional team driving innovation in healthcare.
  • A competitive salary in a supportive work environment that fosters work-life balance.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development in an international setting.

job.job_title: CISO / Head of IT Security - Fulltime Hybrid
job.job_description:
About Us

Ikerian AG (formerly RetinAI Medical) is a fast-growing medical device software company headquartered in Bern, Switzerland. Our mission is to enable the right decisions sooner in healthcare, through transformative AI & data management solutions for disease screening and monitoring. Join our diverse team of entrepreneurs, developers, researchers, and commercial experts who are collectively shaping the future of healthcare.

The Role

We are seeking a CISO / Head of IT Security to lead our security strategy and internal IT operations. This role is pivotal in safeguarding our digital assets and ensuring the highest standards of data privacy within the medical device software landscape. You will bridge the gap between technical security measures and the strategic needs of our growing global team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and implement the company-wide information security strategy and roadmap.
  • Oversee IT infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security across all systems.
  • Lead compliance efforts for relevant standards such as ISO 27001, SOC2, HIPAA, and GDPR.
  • Manage risk assessments, vulnerability testing, and incident response protocols.
  • Supervise the procurement and management of hardware/software for a distributed workforce.
  • Foster a culture of security awareness through continuous training and policy development.

Requirements

  • 8 years of experience in a similar position (Finance sector start search)
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial and collaborative mindset.
  • University degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; professional certifications (CISSP, CISM) preferred.
  • Significant experience in information security and IT leadership, ideally within the healthcare or finance industry.
  • Expertise in cloud security architecture (AWS) and modern infrastructure tools.
  • Proven ability to manage complex IT projects and data privacy initiatives.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

Benefits

  • A chance to be part of an exceptional team driving innovation in healthcare.
  • A competitive salary in a supportive work environment that fosters work-life balance.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development in an international setting.

This role is pivotal in scaling our business development efforts. 

Responsibilities:

    • Have a good understanding of the RetinAI / Ikerain current and evolving portfolio of products and services and be able to advise others about them
    • Research and identify targets in the segments we are interested in (Pharma, Biotech and CROs focused on eye care)
    • Identify and seek out appropriate contacts in target organizations, leveraging publicly available sources and personal networks 
    • Generate leads and cold call prospective customers 
    • Meet with prospects and customers face to face or over the phone
    • Develop compelling pitches based on analysis of the organization and potential customer needs
    • Foster and develop relationships with prospects and customers
    • Understand the needs of your potential customers and be able to respond effectively with a plan of how to meet these
    • Think strategically - seeing the bigger picture and setting aims and objectives in order to develop and improve the business, and identify new opportunities in target markets and adjacent segments 
    • Work strategically - carrying out necessary planning in order to implement changes, for example working closely with Customer Success, Research, Marketing,Product and Operational colleagues
    • Draw up client contracts working with relevant internal teams (operations and legal)
    • Support the onboarding of new customers, working closely with Customer Success and members of the broader team to ensure the successful start to the project and transition of the relationship to account management
    • Manage and grow accounts from project to project

  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial and collaborative mindset
  • Bachelor’s degree ideally in life sciences, computer science or related field, PhD/ MBA a plus
  • 5+ years of experience in business development management consulting or other customer-facing role, experience of scale - up environments a plus 
  • Proven track record of consultative sales with Ophthalmology Pharma, Biotech, MedTech and / or Clinical Research Organizations (CROs)
  • Tech savvy ideally with experience in digital health or health IT 
  • Experience working with cross functional teams (sales, marketing, development)
  • Experience working with complex, multi-divisional, multi-geographical customers; experience in healthcare environments (i.e. clinics and hospitals) a plus
  • Strong interpersonal skills with impressive executive presence and communication abilities
  • Tenacity and drive to seek new business and meet or exceed targets
  • Technical aptitude and ability to learn 
  • Ability to create structure in ambiguous situations to design and implement effective processes 
  • A strong drive for action and a passion for technology and customer success

Skills 

  • Ability to think strategically
  • Negotiating skills
  • Ability to analyze sales figures and write reports
  • Flexible approach to work with the ability to adapt to a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
  • Initiative taking and confidence to start things from scratch
  • Project management and organizational skills
  • Team Working skills and a collaborative approach to work
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Experience with Customer Relationship Management software such as Hubspot

    • A chance to be part of an exceptional team driving innovation in healthcare.
    • A competitive salary in a supportive work environment that fosters work-life balance.
    • Opportunities for professional growth and development in an international setting.
    • A culture of collaboration and inclusion, which is fundamental to our ethos.
    • Occasional travel to our HQ in Switzerland, immersing you in our core operations and company culture.

About Us

Ikerian AG (formerly RetinAI Medical) is a fast-growing medical device software company headquartered in Bern, Switzerland. Our mission is to enable the right decisions sooner in healthcare, through transformative AI & data management solutions for disease screening and monitoring. Join our diverse team of entrepreneurs, developers, researchers, and commercial experts who are collectively shaping the future of healthcare.

Job Description

We are looking for a Client Executive to join our team, focused on the Pharma Segment. As a Client Executive you’ll identify new business opportunities in order to generate revenue, improve profitability and help the business grow. Your work will involve careful strategic planning and positioning in the appropriate markets, enhancing the operation of the business and our positioning in the market. The role, reporting to VP Business Development, will be part of a growing team.

Key Responsibilities

Market Intelligence & Strategic Planning

  • Build and maintain an in-depth understanding of RetinAI’s evolving software and services portfolio to confidently advise and educate prospective clients.
  • Actively research, map, and update intelligence on target organizations across eye-care-focused Pharma, Biotech, and CRO segments.
  • Identify new market opportunities and adjacent segments, setting clear long-term business development objectives.

Pipeline & Deal Generation

  • Proactively identify and engage key decision-makers within target organizations using personal networks, industry databases, and cold outreach.
  • Analyze prospect workflows and clinical needs to develop and deliver highly compelling, tailored solution pitches (remotely and in-person).
  • Lead the commercial proposal process, collaborating closely with internal legal and operational teams to draft and finalize client contracts.

Account Management & Internal Collaboration

  • Partner with Customer Success, Research, Marketing, and Product teams to ensure seamless client onboarding and a successful project kick-off.
  • Foster and deepen senior-level client relationships, ensuring high customer satisfaction to expand accounts from project-based deals to long-term enterprise partnerships.

Requirements

Education & Core Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field; an MBA or PhD is a strong plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in business development, client executive roles, or management consulting, with a preference for fast-paced scale-up environments.
  • A proven track record of consultative sales within Ophthalmology Pharma, Biotech, MedTech, or Clinical Research Organizations (CROs).
  • Experience managing complex, multi-divisional, and multi-geographical client accounts, including healthcare environments (clinics and hospitals).

Technical & Operational Skills

  • Domain knowledge in digital health, health IT, or software platforms, with a strong technical aptitude and a passion for technology.
  • Demonstrated success working alongside cross-functional internal teams, including Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Product Development.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguous environments by creating structure, designing workflows, and implementing effective new processes.

Mindset & Interpersonal Attributes

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage and influence stakeholders at the executive level.
  • A tenacious, results-driven professional with an entrepreneurial mindset and a proven commitment to meeting or exceeding sales targets.

Skills 

  • Strategic & Autonomous Execution: A self-starter who thinks strategically, takes the initiative to build processes from scratch, and works effectively both independently and within teams.
  • Commercial Acumen & Negotiation: Strong negotiation skills combined with the ability to analyze sales metrics, interpret data, and compile actionable reports.
  • Agility & Problem-Solving: A results-oriented problem solver who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly evolving scale-up environments.
  • Organization & Tools: Solid project management and organizational skills, with hands-on proficiency in CRM platforms like HubSpot.

Benefits

  • A chance to be part of an exceptional team driving innovation in healthcare.
  • A competitive salary in a supportive work environment that fosters work-life balance.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development in an international setting.
  • A culture of collaboration and inclusion, which is fundamental to our ethos.
  • Occasional travel to our HQ in Switzerland, immersing you in our core operations and company culture.

job.job_title: Head of Commercial - Full Time - CH
job.job_description:
About Us

Ikerian AG (formerly RetinAI, now part of Essilor Luxottica) is a fast-growing software company headquartered in Bern, Switzerland. Our mission is to enable the right decisions sooner in healthcare, through transformative AI & data management solutions to better understand patients and diseases. Join our diverse team of entrepreneurs, developers, researchers, and commercial experts who are collectively shaping the future of healthcare and eyecare.

Job Description

The Head of Commercial is the head of Ikerian’s market footprint and global revenue growth. Your mission is to optimize a complex revenue mix spanning scalable clinical SaaS, bespoke research collaborations, and Data-Driven Intelligence solutions for the pharma and clinical segment. You will professionalize our commercial engine by ensuring operational excellence while bridging the gap between innovation and global demand. As a key leader within the company and the EssilorLuxottica ecosystem, you will orchestrate strategic partnerships and implement new commercial concepts across global distribution models to maximize corporate synergies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Direct and execute the commercial strategy for multiple revenue streams, balancing clinics sales with high-value life science and pharma services and bespoke research collaborations.
  • Orchestrate the expansion of data-driven intelligence solutions (including RWE and Candidate Identification), establishing high-value partnerships to deliver advanced clinical insights to the industry.
  • Partner with EssilorLuxottica leadership to execute group-wide commercial synergies, such as retail expansion and clinical distribution via the global affiliate network.
  • Leverage and empower internal subject matter expertise to deepen Key Opinion Leader (KOL) relationships and strategic partnerships, ensuring our commercial voice remains scientifically rigorous.
  • Institutionalize a data-driven sales methodology and modern workflows, defining a cadence and rhythm that is tracked through a commercial record to ensure scalable and professionalized growth.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to the commercial team to ensure a unified approach to revenue generation.
  • Professionalize the end-to-end commercial financial lifecycle by standardizing pricing tiers and commission structures while optimizing the quote-to-cash cycle to ensure all contracts are aligned with accurate resource costing and seamless invoicing.
  • Collaborate with the Research department to align market demand with project selection, establishing clear resource-allocation frameworks that balance immediate financial performance with long-term strategic R&D value.
  • Translate market intelligence and competitor trends into proactive commercial strategies, ensuring customer needs directly inform the technical roadmap and position Ikerian as a strategic partner to both pharma, clinics and clinical networks.
  • Transform Customer Operations into a value-driven "Success" engine that maximizes lifetime value (LTV) through renewals, expansions, and upselling.
  • Oversee brand strategy and marketing execution to ensure Ikerian remains a distinctive, top-of-mind leader at international conferences and digital channels.
  • Monitor and optimize company-wide revenue KPIs, delivering transparent reporting on ARR, project margins, and pipeline velocity to drive strategic decision-making.

Requirements

  • Degree in Business/STEM/Law (MBA/PhD preferred). Fluent English + a major European language (DE/IT/FR) preferred. Swiss/EU work authorization required.
  • Proven track record in scaling software solutions within the healthcare sector, with specific expertise in navigating the procurement and implementation cycles of pharma, large-scale hospital systems and clinical networks.
  • Demonstrated ability to design "Value-Exchange" business models, specifically regarding the use of software platforms to facilitate data acquisition and commercialization.
  • Strong background in consultative selling to Life Science stakeholders such as Big Pharma, with a record of closing large, long-cycle deals that require significant market education.
  • Ability to orchestrate a multi-revenue model, balancing the differing cadences of clinical software and pharma research services.
  • Strong foundation in partnership strategy, specifically negotiating complex data-sharing, distribution, or collaboration agreements.
  • Senior experience scaling HealthTech, MedTech, or Life Science B2B enterprise software during a high-growth phase. Ophthalmology and regulatory (MDR/FDA) expertise is a plus.
  • Experience in commercial financial governance including the ability to manage departmental budgets and oversee contract negotiations. 
  • Demonstrated expertise in Data-Driven Revenue Management, including the professionalization of CRMs and standardized commercial KPIs.
  • Experience in strategic organizational design and leadership, building incentive models and workflows that align Sales with the rest of the organization.
  • Willingness to travel globally to represent Ikerian at leadership events and clinical conferences.

Benefits

  • A unique opportunity to lead the evolution of a high-tech healthcare AI subsidiary within a world-leading healthcare group.
  • A competitive compensation package in a supportive environment that values work-life balance.
  • The chance to shape the future of digital health and AI-driven eye care.
  • A central role in a diverse, international team driving meaningful innovation for patients worldwide.

job.job_title: Head of Operations - Full time - CH
job.job_description:
About Us

Ikerian AG (formerly RetinAI Medical, now part of Essilor Luxottica) is a fast-growing medical device software company headquartered in Bern, Switzerland. Our mission is to enable the right decisions sooner in healthcare, through transformative AI & data management solutions to better understand patients and diseases for disease screening and monitoring. Join our diverse team of entrepreneurs, developers, researchers, and commercial experts who are collectively shaping the future of healthcare and eyecare.

Job Description

The Head of Operations is the head of Ikerian’s operational maturity and global scaling. Your mission is to install a high-performance 'Operating System’ that synchronizes Research, Development, and Commercial engines into a unified machine, driven by scalable organizational processes and the leadership of cross-functional teams including Project Management, Human Resources,and Quality & Regulatory Affairs. As the primary custodian of our external ecosystem, you will professionalize our vendor management and institutionalize our internal knowledge infrastructure and processes. Following Ikerian’s acquisition by EssilorLuxottica, you will lead the evolution from a high-growth startup to a world-class subsidiary, ensuring our complex dual-business model is anchored by a robust, compliant, and transparent operational framework.

Key Responsibilities

  • Direct the company’s core operational departments, providing executive leadership and mentorship to the heads of PMO, QRA, and HR.
  • Implement a structured "Operating System" to synchronize deployment across the organization, and align technical development and commercial readiness.
  • Optimize organizational design and workflows to ensure the dual-business model can scale efficiently, professionalizing HR and operational processes without introducing inefficiencies.
  • Modernize and govern the internal knowledge infrastructure and digital workspace to ensure a single, audited "Source of Truth" for all corporate and technical data.
  • Design and lead the company-wide objective-setting framework, ensuring that strategic goals from the CEO and Board are translated into measurable, synchronized departmental targets that eliminate conflicting priorities
  • Professionalize the vendor management lifecycle, overseeing the selection, compliance, and performance of all external service providers and partners.
  • Act as the executive lead for legal compliance, interfacing with external counsel and EssilorLuxottica legal stakeholders to manage corporate risk in collaboration with the finance and accounting department.
  • Support the post-merger integration, harmonizing Ikerian’s operations with global corporate standards while maintaining the organization's agility and innovation speed.
  • Direct the Project Management Office (PMO) to ensure the disciplined execution of both internal strategic initiatives and external client-facing projects.
  • Oversee the HR and Talent Acquisition strategy to scale headcount and foster a high-performance culture that attracts and retains world-class talent.
  • Drive the high-level Regulatory and Quality strategy, ensuring the organization is operationally equipped to achieve and maintain global product clearances (e.g., FDA 510(k)/De Novo and EU MDR).

Requirements

  • University degree in Business, Law, Engineering, or a relevant scientific field; an MBA or PhD is preferred given the technical nature of our products.
  • Proven track record in operational integration within the MedTech Software industry, Health Information Technology.
  • A minimum of 10 years of leadership experience, with a documented history of scaling a company from a small team to a mid-sized enterprise
  • Demonstrated expertise in building and professionalizing "Operating Systems" to synchronize cross-functional teams and minimize departmental silos.
  • Strong foundation in Information Architecture and Knowledge Management, with experience structuring digital workspaces.
  • Direct experience navigating complex regulatory pathways (such as FDA or MDR), or highly regulated environments and managing internal Quality Management Systems. 
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multi-faceted projects involving complex technical, legal, and human resource components.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills and a collaborative mindset capable of leading diverse, international teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with an eye for operational detail and financial efficiency.
  • Ability to work independently as an executive leader while functioning as a core member of the company leadership.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Current residency in Switzerland (or willingness to relocate) with the ability to work from the Bern headquarters as needed.

Benefits

  • A unique opportunity to lead the evolution of a high-tech healthcare AI subsidiary within a world-leading healthcare group.
  • A competitive compensation package in a supportive environment that values work-life balance.
  • The chance to shape the future of digital health and AI-driven eye care.
  • A central role in a diverse, international team driving meaningful innovation for patients worldwide.

job.job_description:
About Us

Ikerian AG (formerly RetinAI Medical) is a fast-growing medical device software company headquartered in Bern, Switzerland. Our mission is to enable the right decisions sooner in healthcare, through transformative AI & data management solutions for disease screening and monitoring. Join our diverse team of entrepreneurs, developers, researchers, and commercial experts who are collectively shaping the future of healthcare.

Job Description

We are looking for a Head of Quality & Regulatory Affairs (QRA) to join our company in Bern, Switzerland. This role is pivotal in driving our internal operational maturity and ensuring global compliance across our expanding product portfolio. Following Ikerian’s acquisition by EssilorLuxottica, you will lead the evolution of the QRA department from a high-growth startup environment to a world-class subsidiary operation. You will oversee global product clearances for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), optimize our Quality Management System (QMS), and serve as a strategic partner to internal R&D, Research, and global sister companies like Heidelberg Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor a global QRA team located across various time zones, establishing a supportive, high-performance team culture driven by clear accountability, structured goal-setting, and skills development.
  • Act as the legal Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) under EU MDR to ensure device conformity, keep technical documentation up to date, and oversee post-market surveillance and vigilance reporting obligations.
  • Develop and execute robust global regulatory strategies with an emphasis on securing and maintaining rapid market access via FDA submissions and CE-MDR compliance frameworks.
  • Govern and scale a world-class Quality Management System (QMS) ensuring continuous organizational readiness for ISO 13485 and the Medical Device Single Audit Program (MDSAP).
  • Serve as the primary corporate representative during all internal, Notified Body, partner, and health authority audits to ensure the continuous validation of corporate certifications.
  • Establish structured cross-functional alignment with R&D to seamlessly integrate design controls, risk management, and software lifecycles into early product development stages.
  • Partner with the IT Infrastructure and Security functions to support data privacy governance frameworks including GDPR and HIPAA compliance while aligning quality processes with emerging cybersecurity standards.
  • Translate market intelligence and evolving global regulations into proactive compliance roadmaps to ensure customer specifications and changing health authority standards are built into the corporate lifecycle.

Requirements

  • University degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Law, or a relevant scientific discipline; a PhD or MBA is a strong asset.
  • A minimum of 10 years of professional experience with a documented track record of successfully leading, managing, and mentoring cross-functional quality and regulatory teams.
  • A minimum of 5 years of dedicated industry experience in medical device Quality and Regulatory Affairs specifically focused on Software as a Medical Device (SaMD).
  • Proven track record as a legal Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) with deep experience managing complex technical files for EU MDR and FDA submissions.
  • Expert technical knowledge of ISO 13485, EU MDR, IEC 62304 software lifecycles, ISO 14971 risk management, and FDA 21 CFR Part 820. Formal Lead Auditor certification is highly valued.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multi-faceted projects involving complex technical, clinical data, and regulatory evaluation components across international borders.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with an exceptional eye for process detail, operational efficiency, and structural quality.
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial and collaborative mindset with excellent team-building and conflict-resolution capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently as a leader.
  • Available to work during Central European Time (CET) business hours with a regular physical presence at our Bern headquarters.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • A chance to be part of an exceptional global team driving innovation in healthcare.
  • A competitive salary in a supportive work environment that fosters work-life balance.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development in an international setting.
  • A culture of collaboration and inclusion, which is fundamental to our ethos.
  • Occasional travel to our HQ in Switzerland, immersing you in our core operations and company culture.
